item: Your bank's actual rate and fees
what_was_found: Three more banks' official tariffs were read (Agricultural Bank, Construction Bank, China Merchants Bank) and one more rate board (China Merchants Bank). ICBC and Bank of Communications publish their tariffs as images, which could not be read. Branch quotes and negotiated rates remain unknown.

Bank of America and Chase each publish USD 15 for an incoming wire. China Merchants Bank publishes a pre-charge of USD 25 or more for the correspondent bank under the OUR option. Fees deducted by banks along the route under SHA remain unpublished.

Article 9(2) caps the tax in the paying company's country at 10 percent of the gross dividend when the beneficial owner is a resident of the other country. The main dashboard prices the dividend route at 20 percent. Whether a U.S. citizen living in China counts as a U.S. resident under the treaty was not determined.

The Ministry of Finance stated in writing that China has not introduced an inheritance tax and has never issued inheritance tax rules or a draft. The statement is dated 21 August 2017; no later statement was read.

The statute sets the willful maximum at the greater of USD 100,000 or 50 percent of the balance in the account at the time of the violation. The main dashboard reports the inflation-adjusted form of the USD 100,000 figure (USD 165,353).

Value-added tax from 1 January 2026: 3 percent of the full price when the home was bought less than 2 years before the sale, exempt at 2 years or more. Deed tax and land appreciation tax were not read.

Two providers publish terms for sending out of mainland China: Wise (own-name transfers for foreigners with Chinese tax records) and Western Union (cash pickup through partner banks). Neither price was read.
